Make it make sense.

Donald Trump keeps trying to restrict mail-in voting — but just voted by mail for the SECOND time this year.

Clearly, the “problem” isn’t election integrity. It’s who gets to vote.
posts.summary: Criticizes Trump for restricting mail-in voting while using it himself
